reviews.text: Instant Air and Heat provided outstanding service from start to finish. The technician was professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to thoroughly inspect everything while clearly explaining the results. I appreciated their honesty, attention to detail, and friendly attitude. It’s great to work with a company that truly cares about customer satisfaction and quality service. Highly recommend Instant Air and Heat for anyone needing reliable HVAC service.

Very professional and courteous. Mark and the crew were skilled, efficient and didn't leave a mess. They were mindful to wash their hands before touching anything inside my office and vacuumed before leaving. Very pleased and beating the heat with the new AC...highly recommend!

The team from Instant Heating and Air arrived on time, their responsiveness and reliability gave me confidence, and I appreciated the follow up to make sure everything was working perfectly. I highly recommend them for any HVAC repair services.

Placed a claim through my warranty and this is the company they had chosen. They were able to send a person by the very next morning who got us up and running that morning (Mark Lopez). Thanks again for all the help!

Mark came to inspect and explained his findings in a way that a non-havc person, such as myself, could easily understand. It really felt like he gave an honest opinion on moving forward rather than a sales pitch. I will definitely call Instant Heating & Air next time I need service.  You should too.
